text:
maria_cs: Quick sync — we're in final week of the renewal sprint with VelaCorp. CFO said they prefer EFT (no PO). Legal also flagged a term tweak (15 months instead of 12). Need to confirm: who signs, where finance should send bank details, and when eng can start private deployment onboarding. cc @ryan_sales @sarah_fin @lee_engr
ryan_sales: I can own the signature loop. I'll confirm the signer today. Are they okay with electronic signature or do they need wet ink?
sarah_fin: EFT is fine but we need their vendor code for our AP system and the bank details in secure portal. Do we have their vendor code? If not, finance needs the legal entity + tax ID.
maria_cs: I have the tax ID in the account doc. Vendor code is missing. I'll ping their procurement for vendor code and bank account confirmation.
lee_engr: For private deployment handoff, we need VPC peering details and an initial config template. ETA for that info will determine when eng can start — ideally by Thurs so we can begin next week.
julia_onboard: I'll schedule the enablement kickoff as soon as VPC info and a signed SOW are in. Proposed slots Thu 2pm or Fri 10am. Which works?anita_legal: Re: term change — legal is ok with 15 months but wants a 60-day termination clause and confirmation that data residency stays the same. Also need the final SOW attached to the amendment.
maria_cs: @anita_legal thanks. I'll confirm data residency (they're staying in EU region only). I'll attach SOW once Ryan confirms the signature path.
ryan_sales: I spoke to their GC — e-sign is acceptable. They want sign-off from CFO + Head of Engineering. I'll loop them both now.
sarah_fin: Finance prefers bank details via secure upload form. I'll send the secure link to their AP and add payment terms Net30. Can we accept Net30 with EFT?maria_cs: Yes, Net30 with EFT works for this customer. I'll confirm with them and share the upload link.
lee_engr: One more thing — do we need Dedicated or Private for this term? They committed to a Dedicated pool but asked for private onboarding checklist. If Dedicated, we need commit level and GPU profile.
maria_cs: They want Dedicated but with private network. I'll capture commit details in the SOW.
julia_onboard: For enablement, we also need a list of 6 power users for the training invite. Maria can you collect those?
maria_cs: On it. I'll collect names and send the invite after signature.
ryan_sales: Action items: I will get e-sign approvals from CFO+Eng head today. @sarah_fin to send secure upload link to VelaCorp AP. @maria_cs to get vendor code, tax ID (we have), and user list. @lee_engr once VPC details are provided, you can schedule handoff.
sarah_fin: Sending secure link now. Will update thread when AP confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:
maria_cs: Update — procurement sent vendor code `VC-9983` and bank contact. They said bank will use an EFT routing form. I'll upload to secure portal and ping finance.
sarah_fin: Got it. I'll watch for the upload and confirm once it's in our AP.
lee_engr: Thanks. If they can get VPC cidr+peering ASN by EOD tomorrow, we can start the private deploy next Monday.
anita_legal: Once Ryan posts the signed amendment, I'll attach the 15mo clause + 60-day termination language and stamp it.
ryan_sales: Put both signatures on the doc now, routing to CFO then Eng head. Expect final e-sign by EOD.
maria_cs: Great — final checklist: signed amendment, vendor code uploaded, EFT bank info in secure portal, user list for enablement, VPC details. Once all in place we'll confirm go/no-go for next Monday.
julia_onboard: I'll tentatively book Thu 2pm enablement and mark as tentative until signatures confirmed.
sarah_fin: AP confirmed receipt of bank details. They uploaded the form and attached a remittance email. I'll confirm on payment terms after signature.
ryan_sales: E-sign complete — both signatures in place. Uploading final PDF now.
anita_legal: I received the signed amendment, added clause, and stamped. Sending final to finance and ops.
maria_cs: All set on my side — vendor code present, bank form uploaded, user list collected and invite sent. VPC info incoming tomorrow.
lee_engr: Perfect. We'll start private deployment on Monday morning assuming VPC details arrive tonight.
maria_cs: Thanks team — closing sprint tasks. I'll follow up if any blockers. :rocket:
